hero.title: Who gets rich from get-rich-quick? Mostly the person selling it.
hero.lede: Day trading, dropshipping, faceless channels, MLM, coaching: every scheme has a video promising a path to $10k a month. This page collects what those videos claim and checks it against what the data says happens to the people who follow them.

recap.bottomLine: none of the pitched schemes survives contact with the data: day traders, CFD, options and boom-time crypto buyers mostly lose, most MLM participants earn nothing or lose money, and buyers of coaching, seminar and done-for-you packages rarely recoup the fee. What holds up is the unglamorous route: decades of compounding, a business that takes years of real work, and the observation that the seller of a method earns more than its buyers. {hypeWrong} of {hypeTotal} "anyone can" and "$10k a month" style claims are judged wrong.
